title: Arrakis design-repo PageSpec
description: The machine contract for a generated page. Draft-07. `additionalProperties: false` everywhere. Every node variant is a FULLY INDEPENDENT schema inside one `oneOf` — never a shared base plus allOf patches, because draft-07 evaluates `additionalProperties:false` only against a schema's OWN `properties` and cannot see properties a sibling allOf branch adds (BUILD-GUIDE §2.5, the known draft-07 trap).

route.description: Closed to the 12 real routes plus the `*` catch-all. /industries and /careers are deliberately absent — both 404 on the original.

template.description: Closed template enum. semantic_validate.py cross-references this against the named template's OWN node list — it does not validate nodes[] in isolation.

theme.description: The site has no light/dark switcher and no prefers-color-scheme handling. These are the two real SURFACE MODES that alternate section by section within one theme.

motion.description: CLOSED to exactly two fields, both const-locked to this section type's measured values. Per BUILD-GUIDE §2.5 a per-section-type motion enum with const-locked fallbacks is the right form here (not one global generic fade), because these sections have distinctive scroll/marquee/carousel behaviour that must not silently fall back to something unrelated. The measured timing detail lives in sections/<id>.json and motion/motion-spec.json, not in a generated instance.
